_doc: walter-llm shipped defaults. An instance overrides them in config/llm/gateway.json. Paths: absolute, ~/ or @instance/.

test_budget._doc: Runs of channel test (walter-scenario, walter-lab): paid-provider spend cap per window; above it the owner approves (walter-llm test-budget approve EUR). Owner decision 2026-10-30.

web_services._doc: Conversational web interfaces used as services (Router rule → Browse recipe host/capability, engine session, owner login site from browser_sites). Browse learns/replays the recipe; no LLM on a validated recipe. Enabled only by the owner.

chatgpt.note: Disabled: OpenAI's Terms of Use forbid automatically or programmatically extracting output from ChatGPT; owner decision pending (DECISIONS 2026-11-08).
